slot.brief: Give formula [Co(NH3)4Cl2]+ type; count/identify the geometrical isomers possible.

stem: The number of geometrical isomers possible for the complex ion [Co(NH3)4Cl2]+ is

verdicts.working: For an octahedral MA4B2 complex, the two Cl ligands can be cis or trans, giving 2 geometrical isomers.

working:
The complex is octahedral of type Ma4b2. The two chloride ligands can be adjacent, giving the cis isomer, or opposite, giving the trans isomer. Therefore two geometrical isomers are possible.

Independent check: For an octahedral MA4B2 complex, the two Cl ligands can be cis or trans, giving 2 geometrical isomers.
solution:
The complex is octahedral and has the type $MA_4B_2$. The two Cl ligands can be adjacent (cis) or opposite (trans):
$$\text{Number of geometrical isomers}=2$$
